---
title: "Volume II"
subtitle: "Scaling Machine Learning Systems"
---

Lecture decks for Volume II, which takes the systems of Volume I to fleets of machines. Every lecture comes as a PDF for projection, a PDF with the notes below each slide for study, a PowerPoint file whose notes pane holds the speaker notes, and the LaTeX source. Each chapter also has a two-page study sheet for students, linked beside the chapter: the front is what to learn and the back is practice.
